App.name: RegShield CA
App.tagline: Verify credentials. Avoid scams. Find help faster.

Home.title: RegShield CA
Home.subtitle: A California-focused safety layer for immigration legal help: verification + scam signals + faster referrals.

verify.title: Credential verification
verify.body: Search DOJ EOIR Recognition & Accreditation rosters and follow official links for CA State Bar and CA SOS.

shield.title: Scam shield
shield.body: Turn warnings into a checklist. Build a local, encrypted evidence vault you control.

help.title: Referral accelerator
help.body: Simple triage to find organizations by county, language and intake status.

Common.informationOnlyBody: RegShield CA provides public information and official roster lookups. It does not provide legal advice.

Verify.title: Verify
Verify.description: Check whether a person or organization appears on official rosters. We show evidence links and explain what it means.
Verify.stateHint: Organizations are filtered by state. Accredited representatives are searched nationally.
Verify.disclaimer: We do not confirm someone is authorized to represent you in all contexts. Always verify via official sources.

officialLinks.title: Official verification links (manual check)
officialLinks.calbarBody: If someone claims to be an attorney, verify their status directly with the State Bar of California.
officialLinks.sosBody: If someone claims to be an immigration consultant in California, check registration and compliance.

Shield.title: Shield
Shield.description: Spot red flags early. Save evidence locally with encryption. Nothing is uploaded.

actions.receipts: Ask for written agreements and receipts
actions.noBlank: Do not sign blank forms or provide false information

Shield.vaultBody: Create or unlock a vault with a passphrase. Files are stored in your browser only.

Vault.passphraseHint: This is never sent to a server. If you forget it, the vault cannot be recovered.
Vault.importDialogBody: Choose a vault zip export and enter its passphrase.

errors.wrongPassphrase: Could not decrypt. Check the passphrase and try again.

Help.title: Help
Help.description: Lightweight triage (no legal advice). Filter by county, language and service.

Partner.title: Partner portal
Partner.description: Update intake status and availability for your organization.
Partner.missingEnv: Supabase environment variables are not configured. See docs to enable the partner portal.
